_schema: REAL detagged spans from www.schwab.wallst.com fund summary pages, captured 2026-11-14/15, trimmed verbatim to the span holding BOTH the header quote group and the detail block. Used by scripts/fund-facts-extract-test.mjs. Each records what the PAGE states: headerYtd is the month-end prospectus figure the extractor must NOT publish; detailYtd with ytdAsOf is the current one it must; er with erAsOf comes from the prospectus label, not the quote date.
